start: Android 14 phone, notifications on, 'Alarms & reminders' off for MettleUp

steps.action: Open Settings > Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: Row 'Rest alerts: May be late — tap to fix'
Caption 'Tap to turn on "Alarms & reminders" in your phone’s settings, so "Rest is over" rings on time'
must_not: The row hidden while rests can come late
The row says 'On time'

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: Android's 'Alarms & reminders' page for MettleUp
must_not: Nothing opens
Another app's page

steps.action: Turn it on and come back to MettleUp
user_sees: The row is gone
must_not: The row still says 'May be late' after the fix

start: Notifications for MettleUp blocked in Android settings

steps.action: Open Settings > Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: Row 'Rest alerts: Off — notifications are blocked'
Caption 'Tap to turn them on'
must_not: No row while no rest alert can show

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: Android's notification page for MettleUp
must_not: A page that cannot turn them on

start: The 'Rest is over' channel muted in Android settings (or by a cleaner app)

steps.action: Open Settings > Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: Row 'Rest alerts: Silent — tap to fix'
Caption 'Android muted "Rest is over" for MettleUp. Turn its sound back on'
must_not: 'On time' while the channel is muted

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: Android's page of the muted channel itself
must_not: The page of a channel that is fine

start: Android background restriction on for MettleUp

steps.action: Open Settings > Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: Row 'Rest alerts: May be late — tap to fix'
Caption 'Android is holding MettleUp back in the background. Allow it'
must_not: No warning

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: MettleUp's own Android app page
must_not: Nothing opens

start: Every alert setting allowed (or an iPhone)

steps.action: Open Settings > Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: No 'Rest alerts' row at all
must_not: A 'Rest alerts' row with an empty caption
An error or a spinner

start: All alerts work; the member then mutes 'Rest is over' in Android settings

steps.action: Go back to MettleUp
user_sees: Row 'Rest alerts: Silent — tap to fix' appears without a restart
must_not: The row only after the app is killed

steps.action: Turn the channel back on in Android, go back
user_sees: The row disappears
must_not: The row stays after the fix
